component.name: Obs Lite
component.summary: Record the screen using few resources

description.p: A lightweight screen recorder whose interface follows OBS Studio, so OBS users find everything where they expect it. It is not affiliated with the OBS Project.

ul.li: Records the screen or a window, chosen in the desktop's sharing dialog
Desktop audio and microphone, each with a meter, volume and mute
Pause, a region of the screen, screenshots and a webcam overlay
Replay buffer: keeps the last seconds in memory and saves them on demand
Global hotkeys, kept by the desktop
H.264 and AAC in MP4, on the GPU when it has an encoder

description.p: The interface follows the system language: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese or Chinese.

screenshot.caption: Recording, with the preview, the sources, the audio mixer and the controls

description.p: The interface is also in Brazilian Portuguese. File › Export Settings saves a copy of the settings wherever you choose, and on Windows a settings.json next to obs-lite.exe keeps the portable version's settings in its own folder.

On Windows, the new-version notice links to the website, which offers the same kind of file as the installed or portable copy, and a copy installed with the installer can update itself with Update now: the new installer is downloaded, checked against its SHA-256 and installed, and Obs Lite opens again. Nothing changes on Linux.

The webcam can be placed anywhere on the recording and at any size, by dragging it on the preview, and each source's options are on a right click. Repairing a recording after a crash is safer, a region that no longer fits is refused instead of recording the whole source, the window no longer freezes while the screen-sharing dialog is open, and hotkeys keep working with Settings open during a recording.

Starting a recording no longer freezes the window, and the webcam works with older PipeWire. A recording whose finishing was cut short is repaired at the next start, an unreadable setting no longer resets the others, and the app is called Obs Lite everywhere.
The interface is also in German, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, Japanese and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

Recording with VA-API (Intel, AMD) keeps the frames on the GPU: about a quarter of the CPU it took, and half with a region and the webcam. Pausing no longer pauses the replay buffer, and many fixes: recordings that cannot be written, a computer that sleeps while recording, the video drifting from the audio when frames are skipped, a webcam unplugged while recording.
Recordings survive a crash or a power cut, and are repaired at the next start.
